scripts.server:check: pnpm --dir packages/protocol run test && pnpm --dir apps/server run check && pnpm --dir apps/server run db:check && pnpm --dir apps/server run test
scripts.web:check: pnpm -r run check && pnpm --filter @vibevalley/host run test && pnpm --filter vibevalley-mobile run test && pnpm --filter vibevalley-web run build
scripts.desktop:test: pnpm --filter vibevalley-web run build && pnpm --filter vibevalley-desktop run test
scripts.docs:verify: vpx scripts/agent-notes.ts && vpx scripts/skills.ts && vpx scripts/doc-links.ts && vpx scripts/stale-names.ts && vpx scripts/capabilities.ts --check && vpx scripts/api-client.ts --check
scripts.site:check: pnpm --dir site install --ignore-workspace && pnpm --dir site run check
scripts.site:build: pnpm --dir site install --ignore-workspace && pnpm --dir site run build
scripts.site:deploy: pnpm --dir site install --ignore-workspace && pnpm --dir site run deploy
